title: Beau Soir
identity: The cataloged edition is Eugene Rousseau’s alto saxophone and piano transcription, published by Lauren Keiser Music as HL 41527 / X151012. Hal Leonard identifies it as Grade III and six pages. The underlying Debussy song is for voice and piano; other saxophone arrangements exist and must not be conflated with Rousseau’s edition.

evidence.claim: Publisher identifies Rousseau arrangement for alto saxophone and piano, Grade III, six pages, HL 41527 / X151012.
IMSLP record identifies Beau soir as a voice-and-piano song and separately hosts a 2015 alto saxophone arrangement by Jacques Larocque, distinct from the cataloged Rousseau edition.
Noa Even’s performer repertoire page lists Beau Soir among saxophone and piano repertoire.

collection_flag: Transcription of Debussy’s art song for voice and piano. The cataloged Rousseau edition is a six-page alto-saxophone version; suitability as lyrical transcription is an inference and requires review of the edition.

score_links.description: IMSLP record includes a free Jacques Larocque alto-saxophone arrangement, not the cataloged Rousseau edition; no notation observation transferred to the Rousseau version.

gaps: No readable Rousseau score preview or matching performance recording was verified.
Other public saxophone arrangements have different arrangers, durations and technical choices; do not transfer those to the Rousseau edition.
